capabilities: Group ribbon buttons into labeled, color-coded sections
Drag buttons between groups on the ribbon itself
Collapse, hide or disable whole groups
Reorder groups and buttons in a settings pane
Export and import group layouts as JSON
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+ and depends on the private app.workspace.leftRibbon object, so Obsidian updates could break it; the settings tab shows diagnostics if the ribbon structure is not found. No network requests or account.
problem: With a dozen plugins installed, the left ribbon becomes one long column of unrelated icons with no way to group or label them.
summary: Ribbon organizer that splits the left ribbon into labeled, color-coded groups and lets you reorder buttons by dragging them between groups.
